latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Drop Spindle Spinning Basics — a guide for turning raw fiber into yarn when commercial supplies are unreliable.

- Identifies suitable local fibers from photos or inventory and calculates precise twist ratios and yields.
- Generates step-by-step preparation, spinning, and plying schedules with reminders to keep you on track.
- Tracks yarn thickness, strength tests, and maintains logs for spinning progress and batch improvement.
- Offers templates for inventory management, barter/trade, and safety protocols.
- Clearly separates agent (planning, calculations, safety, reminders) and human (all physical fiber work) roles for efficient teamwork.
